LanguageData.RC_Text_d6a5666e942be14c: Click anywhere to open the mission report
LanguageData.RC_Text_daa352e5cf5599fc: Detection: Counts each guard or camera once on full detection. Yellow suspicion does not count. Reports: Counts each guard once when they first intend to report. Kills: Deaths of managed guards in this mission, including deaths after takedown. Non-lethal takedowns: Successfully subdued guards still alive at debrief. Starts at 100; each detection source costs
LanguageData.RC_Text_6d072f3214a78872: . Takedowns and time do not affect the score. S: 100; A: 85–99; B: 65–84; C: 40–64; D: 0–39.
LanguageData.RC_Text_4b271f53f6f07a2e: Physical inventory items carry into the next mission in their current state.
